The system needs to support both manual and automatic operating modes.\nBased on the value of the mode variable, switch to the corresponding operating mode.\nIn manual mode, control the start and stop of the selected pump based on the value of pumpGroup[1..5].selection.\nIn automatic mode, compare the priority of each pump, and automatically select the 3 pumps with higher priority for water supply according to the method of three in use and two on standby.\n\n## Interface Definition\n\n| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Input | `mode` | `BOOL` | FALSE: Manual mode
TRUE: Automatic mode |\n| Input | `start` | `BOOL` | Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump |\n| Input | `stop` | `BOOL` | Stop button, used to stop all pumps |\n| Input/Output | `pumpGroup` | `ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump` | Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd. |\n\n**Data type `ST_Pump`**\n\n| Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `priority` | `INT` | Priority; larger values have higher priority. Read-only to the function block. |\n| `selection` | `BOOL` | Manual-selection state. Read-only to the function block. |\n| `RunComd` | `BOOL` | Run command written by the function block; TRUE runs and FALSE stops. |", "scenario": "In an industrial water supply system, there are 5 pumps, each of which can be controlled independently. TRUE: Automatic mode" }, { "direction": "INPUT", "name": "start", "type": "BOOL", "description": "Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump" }, { "direction": "INPUT", "name": "stop", "type": "BOOL", "description": "Stop button, used to stop all pumps" }, { "direction": "IN_OUT", "name": "pumpGroup", "type": "ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump", "description": "Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd." } ], "initial_conditions": { "pumpGroup[].RunComd": false }, "scan_semantics": "At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.", "safety_priority": [ "Stop wins over a simultaneous start.", "Read-only priority and selection fields must be unchanged." ], "assumptions": [ "stop has priority over start and clears all five commands.", "A start command selects the running set from current mode/configuration; commands are retained while neither button is TRUE. There is no automatic selection change until another start.", "Equal priorities are resolved by lower array index first.
